gitCommit.subject: test(sort): RED-first diagnostic suite localizing the broken sort→results flow (#207)
gitCommit.body:
test(sort): RED-first diagnostic suite localizing the broken sort→results flow (#207)

* docs: design spec — diagnostic test coverage for the sort flows

Characterize-only (no fixes) diagnostic suite across unit/integration/e2e for
Sorting Session/Triage/Compare/Results; outside-in ordering to localize the
known break; prime suspect purses-r7p (orphaned SortResult creation).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: implementation plan — sort-flow diagnostic test suite

14 tasks across unit/integration/e2e (characterize-only). Pins the confirmed
r7p empty-result break (POST /api/sort-results bypasses createDraftResult) and
the deleteResultItem no-op. Subagent-driven execution.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): PairingService unit coverage (purses-7io)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): PreferenceStateService unit coverage

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): rev-2 — fold spec-review BLOCK

RED-first (test.fails/fixme tripwires, not pin-green); corrected diagnosis
(SortResultService fully orphaned, second stubbed ResultController path,
supersede throws, live mode = no result created at all); reconciled state
(Pairing/PreferenceState done, ScoringService=10 tests); seam tripwire moved
to the always-on integration tier + dedup with existing authz integration;
e2e divergence rewritten to observable live truth; seam-first ordering.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): fold spec re-review nits (it.skip not test.fixme; seam-label tightening)

* docs(plan): rev-2 — RED-first, corrected diagnosis, seam-first order, dedup

Global Constraints now RED-first (test.fails/it.skip quarantine, never pin
broken behavior green). Confirmed diagnosis corrected (two orphaned populating
paths; supersede throws; live mode = no result created). Tasks 1-2 marked DONE;
seam tripwire moved to the always-on integration tier and dedup'd onto the
existing sort-results-authz.integration.test.ts; e2e results spec relabeled
renderer-only + divergence rewritten; report cause derived from the run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): sort-results POST + [id] route coverage — RED tripwire on materialization

POST cases: 401 unauth, 400 missing collectionId/name, 403 access denied,
201 forces curatorId+status draft, and a test.fails tripwire asserting the
intended 'materializes one SortResultItem per preference' behavior — the route
calls SortResultRepository.create directly and never materializes items today,
so the body fails now (suite green) and ERRORS when the route is wired to
materialize, forcing promotion.

[id] cases: GET/PATCH/DELETE each cover 401 / 403 / 404 / success; PATCH adds
400 invalid JSON. Real ResultController runs over a mocked SortResultRepository.

Test files only; no src/** production changes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): integration seam tripwire (live POST -> items) + pipeline cases

Add the always-on db-tests seam tripwire and pipeline characterization for
the result-creation break.

- sort-results-authz.integration.test.ts: RED it.fails() tripwire
  "live POST /api/sort-results materializes one SortResultItem per preference".
  Seeds items + the curator's CollectionPreferenceItem rows, drives the real
  POST un-mocked, then asserts findByResult(newId) is non-empty. Fails today
  (route calls SortResultRepository.create directly, never createDraftResult,
  so [] ); green-as-test.fails now, ERRORS when the route is wired.
- sort-pipeline.integration.test.ts (new): triage decision persists a
  preference in the right bucket (persistence + bucket direction, not scores);
  SortResultService.createDraftResult materializes one item per preference
  ranked by score (characterizes the intended-but-unwired service path).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): finalize/supersede/items/reset route coverage + RED tripwires (supersede, deleteResultItem)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): SessionService/SortResultService/DecisionEventService/SortResultShareService unit coverage

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): sort-results shares route coverage

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): component interaction gaps + seedSortScenario e2e fixture

Task 10 — fill compare/triage/results interaction gaps (no src changes):
- DecisionControls.test.tsx (new): triage tier tap POSTs the right `result`
  (Love→top … Release→low), router.refresh vs onDecisionMade, error re-enable.
- CompareChoice.test.tsx: card tap chooses item_a/item_b, Tie/Skip results,
  refresh on success, gentle error + re-enable.
- results/[resultNumber]/page.test.tsx: tier-count cards (Love/Like/Maybe/Onward),
  per-tier counts, Onward (no "Release"/"Discard") framing, most-loved hero +
  deep-link, full-ranking section, empty state.

Task 11 — seedSortScenario(ownerId) in e2e/fixtures/seed.ts:
- 3 items each with a hero photo + active session + CollectionPreferenceItem rows
  across buckets (top/high/low) + a draft SortResult via
  SortResultService.createDraftResult (the correct path). Renderer-only
  scaffolding that bypasses the broken live route on purpose.
- Returns {collectionId, slug, sessionNumber, itemIds, resultNumber};
  require.main smoke extended to exercise it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): honest RED tripwire for 'Release' tone violation in results (purses-xca)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): e2e journeys for session/triage/compare/results (purses-7dd)

Add three RED-first, characterize-only Playwright journey specs mirroring
sort-images.spec.ts (seedBaseline + seed helper, /file image intercept,
slug/number URLs, shared storageState auth):

- sort-session.spec.ts: start a session via StartSessionForm/sort/new lands
  on a numbered sort URL and triage resolves; reload preserves the session;
  unauth goto of protected sort/compare URLs redirects to /login. The
  "lands DIRECTLY on triage" contract is quarantined test.fixme (the form
  pushes to the session detail page, not /triage).
- compare.spec.ts: "Which do you love more?", tap-to-choose, quiet Tie/Skip,
  gentle progress text, next-pair-or-graceful-end advance.
- results.spec.ts: renderer-only on a seeded populated result — tier sections,
  hero images, most-loved hero, full ranking. Zero diagnostic signal about the
  live sort->result break (no live UI path creates a result; SessionComplete
  is dead). Authoritative seam proof is Task 12's integration tripwire.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(diagnosis): sort-flow failure localization map

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): pin deleteResult no-op (final-review) + fix fixture/report rot

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
